{{Quote|Summation: The fleet was ambushed by a sizable Republic force. Our losses exceeded eighty percent of the vessels, and over twenty thousand Imperial organics.|An HK-51 unit|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
During the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a traitor betrayed the [[Third Imperial Assault Fleet]], leading to an '''ambush''' by the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] that wiped out most of the Imperial fleet. Over twenty thousand Imperial lives were lost, along with more than eighty percent of the ships in the fleet.
